name: API Contract Testing
purpose: Verify REST, GraphQL, and gRPC contracts with schema validation, Pact consumer-driven tests, breaking-change detection, mock servers, and can-i-deploy release gates.
inputs: Provider spec: OpenAPI 3.1 document, GraphQL SDL, or .proto files with version and changelog
Consumer inventory: named consumers, their Pact versions, and supported contract ranges
Compatibility policy: additive-only within major versions, 90-day sunset for removals
CI topology: where verifier, mock, and can-i-deploy gate run in the pipeline
outputs: Verified contract matrix: spec version, consumer versions, verification badges, deployment clearance
Pact interactions and provider states committed alongside the specs
Mock server configuration reproducible in CI and local development
stop_conditions: All interactions verified, can-i-deploy green, mocks spec-valid, zero untriaged breaking changes
Breaking change found requiring consumer negotiation or major-version planning
